description: Use this when the user wants a floor plan drawn as CAD (DXF/DWG) but is not signed in to an AI Architectures account here, or prefers to continue on the website, or wants to attach a sketch there. Returns a link that opens the Plan Chat CAD studio with the request already typed in; nothing is drawn or charged until the user presses send on the site.
